newsitem.title: USA: COTTON--USDA could up import data amid weak prices.
newsitem.headline: COTTON--USDA could up import data amid weak prices.

text.p: Despite a precipitous drop in U.S. cotton prices, foreign imports will continue at a brisk pace and eventually prompt the U.S. Department of Agriculture to raise its current import estimate, industry analysts said.

"While prices have come down and the spread (between domestic and foreign cotton) has narrowed, the difference is still wide enough to attract foreign growths," said O.A. Cleveland, a cotton marketing specialist with Mississippi State University.
